name: Candy Roley Poley
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: quarter of a pound of shelled almonds
ingredients.originalText: a quarter of a pound of shelled almonds

instructions.text: Cut up the citron, stone the raisins, blanch the almonds, hull the peanuts, and cut up the figs into small bits
Take two pounds of coffee-sugar and moisten with vinegar
Put in a piece of butter as large as a walnut
Stew till it hardens, but take off before it gets to the brittle stage
Beat it with a spoon six or eight times
Stir in the mixed fruits and nuts
Pour into a wet cloth and roll it up like a pudding, twisting the ends of the cloth to mold it
Let it get cold and slice off pieces as wanted

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut up the citron, stone the raisins, blanch the almonds, hull the peanuts, and cut up the figs into small bits
2. Take two pounds of coffee-sugar and moisten with vinegar
3. Put in a piece of butter as large as a walnut
4. Stew till it hardens, but take off before it gets to the brittle stage
5. Beat it with a spoon six or eight times
6. Stir in the mixed fruits and nuts
7. Pour into a wet cloth and roll it up like a pudding, twisting the ends of the cloth to mold it
8. Let it get cold and slice off pieces as wanted
